title: StippleDiffusion: Capacity-Constrained Stippling using Controlled Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2605.15816v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Stipple patterns, point sets whose local density tracks a target image, are traditionally produced by per-density iterative optimizers, which are slow, non-differentiable, and must be re-run from scratch for each new target. Learned alternatives have so far addressed only unconditional point generation; capacity-constrained, image-conditioned stippling has remained out of reach. We present the first diffusion-based sampler that simultaneously satisfies a learned local point-distribution prior and a continuous, image-defined capacity constraint at inference. The method is a ControlNet branch built on top of an optimal-transport-grid point-set diffusion baseline, conditioned on the target density map and a high-resolution image. translated_title: StippleDiffusion：基于受控扩散的容量约束点画生成
translated_abstract: 点画图案是指其局部密度跟随目标图像的点集，传统上由针对每种密度的迭代优化器生成，这类方法速度慢、不可微分，且每次面对新目标都必须从头重新运行。已有的学习方法至今只能解决无条件点生成问题；容量约束的、以图像为条件的点画生成一直未能实现。我们提出了首个基于扩散模型的采样器，能够在推理阶段同时满足学习到的局部点分布先验以及连续的、由图像定义的容量约束。该方法是在最优传输网格点集扩散基线之上构建的ControlNet分支，以目标密度图和高分辨率图像为条件。两个设计选择使这一组合切实可行：训练与推理被限制在去噪后期阶段，并以密度加权拒绝采样进行初始化；同时采用标准的零卷积（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出了首个基于扩散模型的点画生成采样器StippleDiffusion，通过在最优传输网格点集扩散基线上添加ControlNet分支，在推理时同时满足学习到的局部点分布先验和由图像定义的容量约束，突破了传统迭代优化方法慢且不可微、以及以往学习方法仅支持无条件点生成的局限。
en_tdlr: The first diffusion-based sampler for capacity-constrained, image-conditioned stippling, built as a ControlNet branch on an optimal-transport-grid point-set diffusion baseline that jointly enforces a learned local point-distribution prior and a continuous image-defined capacity constraint at inference.
